title: In 1990, his empire was $3.4 billion in debt. In 2025, he was sworn in as president again.
caption:
In 1990, his empire was $3.4 billion in debt. In 2025, he was sworn in as president again.

Queens builder's son → the Grand Hyatt, Trump Tower and Atlantic City. Six of his companies filed for bankruptcy; he never did personally, and rebuilt through licensing and golf.

The Apprentice. 304 electoral votes having never held office. A 2020 loss, two impeachments, a 2024 conviction. Then 312 electoral votes and the popular vote.

Love him or hate him: has anyone pulled off a comeback like this?
